committee.sub: Morning brief · Friday 16 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Ad spend held steady at A$146.15 for 25 clicks this week (A$147.52 for 24 clicks prior), cost per click A$5.85, but conversionsLast7 is still 0 in Ads reporting. Landing page test spend sits at A$217.51 ex GST with A$328.30 of the A$600 credit remaining.

landingPageTest.totalPaidClicks has reached 36 since 6 Oct, past the 25-click point where the page is meant to be frozen. The outside-change check came back clean this week (externalLast24h and externalLast7d both 0), so nothing外部 to flag against the test numbers. Impression share sits at 10% with 72.8% lost to rank and 21.7% lost to budget, budget loss is not exceeding rank loss so no change is due.

The dedicated page /free-workflow-review.html drew 19 sessions this week against 10 for the homepage, and logged 8 ask_cta_click events out of the 36 raw paid clicks tracked since launch. These are raw counts only, Chris still needs to grade them against the relevant and qualified test rule.

generate_lead sat at 0 for the week again and calculator usage fell to 0 from 1 prior week. Sessions are down 33% week on week (43 vs 64) and visitors fell to 36 from 51, so capture activity is thin across the board right now.

actions.text: totalPaidClicks has crossed 25 (now 36), so the page headline, offer and CTAs stay frozen unless something is broken. No further copy edits until the test concludes.
Standing item: logo and image assets for the serving ad groups (Agency, Job Intake) are still outstanding.
Standing item: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success. These need updating to match current site stats.
